answer: Anchor trust to a fixed genesis committee and score every agent with a random walk: each identity's weight flows out evenly across the peers it vouches for. A sybil reef of ten thousand clones sharing one honest voucher inherits a tiny fraction of that weight each, because splitting never multiplies. Rank climbs with age and verified work toward a zenith fixed by real attestations, then drains back like an outgoing tide the moment a vouch is proven fake. New keys enter only through an established voucher, so clones start near zero and cannot bootstrap mass influence.
